title: How to Post a Photo Album
breadcrumbs: How to Post a Photo Album
content:
## How to Post a Photo Album


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000002336

To post a Photo Album, access the Member Dashboard, on the left sidebar find the Photo Album post type, click on it to make a new post.

IMPORTANT: If the Photo Albums option is not included in the member dashboard, the post needs to be enabled for the membership plan in the post publishing tab: Finance » Membership Plans - Post Publishing


## Photo Album Form


Add some content to the post, for example a title, description, category and more as explained below:

1. Publish content on the site or save it as a draft.

2. Add the Title of the Photo Album.

3. Select the Category for the album.

4. Enter keywords that apply. Separate with comma.

5. Enter the main Description of the Photo Album.


## Upload Photos


After all of the details have been saved, add the images to the Photo Album post.

Upload as many images as needed (Gifs are not supported):

- Title: Add a Title to the Image.

- Description : Add a Description to the Image

- Rotate : Option to rotate the images.

- Move to...: Move the images to another Photo Album post from the same member.

After adding the photos, there are three additional options:

- Scroll to Bottom : This button is to jump to the bottom of the page quicker when a photo album has many images .

- Display Order : Go to the Photo Display Order screen.

- Save Changes : Save image titles and descriptions.


### Photo Display Order


Arrange the Photo Display Order:

See how the images can be arranged and select the cover image for the post in the following GIF:


## Member Dashboard Options


Different options are available on this section. For more information, please refer to the image and points shown below:

- Photo Albums : Will show all the photo albums and display the amount of albums in the account.

- Add a New Photo Album : Click to add a new photo album. It will not display if the limit of posts has been reached.

- Entries per Page : Click on the dropdown to choose how many entries will show per page (5, 10, 25 or 50 entries).

- Order of the Posts on the Page : Newest, Oldest, Updated (first), Updated (last), Start Date (first), Start Date (last).

- Filter by Status : Published, Draft or Expired.

- Filter by Keyword : Enter a desired keyword to display all photo albums that contain it.


### Photo Album Post Module


Once the Photo Album has been created, it will display the current Status:

- Published

- Draft

- Expired

The number of Views and Bookmarks will only show if the correspondent add ons are active on the site.


### Actions Dropdown


Clicking on the Actions Button reveals additional post options:

- View

- Edit

- Upload Photos

- Clone

- Delete

* Keep in mind that the Clone option will only copy the post details, not the images.
